comment: MACRO-LESS plan to demonstrate SPD step 3: every subgoal has only a goal_text + done_when, no macro. Run 1 with --escalate hands each subgoal to the live model and DISTILLS the successful ops back here as macros; run 2 replays them deterministically (escalations -> 0). This file is mutated in place by distillation.

subgoals.goal_text: You are upstairs (REDS_HOUSE_2F). Take the stairs down to the first floor: use_warp the stairs tile listed in obs.map.warps (its dest is REDS_HOUSE_1F).
You are on the first floor (REDS_HOUSE_1F). Go out the front door into Pallet Town: use_warp the door tile in obs.map.warps whose dest is LAST_MAP (the exit).

From Pallet Town, go NORTH toward Route 1 (cross north). Professor Oak stops you at the town edge and automatically walks you into his lab. Do NOT enter the lab building through its door directly — that will not start the starter event; only heading north triggers Oak.

You are in Oak's lab and Oak has finished his intro. Interact with a starter Poke Ball (obs.map.objects lists them, e.g. OAKSLAB_SQUIRTLE_POKE_BALL), answer YES to take it (menu index 1), and decline the nickname (menu index 2).
